_about: The city's placed landmarks: ONE source for the page (world.js) and the shaders (scene.wgsl). tools/gen-design.mjs writes src/gen/design.js and src/gen/design.wgsl from this file when the page is built (assemble.py). Blocks are big blocks of BIG metres, wrapped every WRAP blocks. 'top' is the landmark's height; 'boundTop' the height the shaders use as its bounding box (it includes what stands on the roof).
